channel.title: Data Governance Journey — Insights
channel.description: Practical writing on data governance, data quality, data literacy, and responsible AI, for the people who have to make it work day to day.

item.title: Identifying and Addressing Data Pain Points: The First Step in Data Governance
item.dc:creator: Sandy Bradbury
item.description: Learn how identifying organizational data pain points—such as silos, quality issues, and ownership gaps—serves as the foundational step for a successful data governance strategy.

item.title: Why Data Governance Is All About People, Process, Technology… and Data
item.dc:creator: Sandy Bradbury
item.description: Explore the Golden Square of enterprise Data Governance—People, Process, Technology, and Data—and learn how aligning these 4 pillars creates a sustainable competitive advantage.

item.title: Introduction to the Basics of a Data Governance Program
item.dc:creator: Sandy Bradbury
item.description: Learn the 6 foundational building blocks needed to launch a pragmatic Data Governance Program that turns raw data into a trusted enterprise asset.

item.title: Unlocking True Data-Driven Potential: Why Data Literacy Rules Governance
item.dc:creator: Sandy Bradbury
item.description: Discover why data literacy is the missing link in your data governance strategy and how to assess your organization's analytics maturity.

item.title: What is Data Governance in DAMA DMBOK? Framework & Key Components
item.dc:creator: Sandy Bradbury
item.description: Discover how the DAMA DMBOK framework defines Data Governance, its core pillars, key roles, and how it integrates across data management to drive real value.

item.title: What Data Governance Is and What It Is Not: 5 Common Misconceptions
item.dc:creator: Sandy Bradbury
item.description: Confused about Data Governance? Discover what Data Governance actually is, what it is not, and how clarifying these myths protects your organization from costly errors.

item.title: Data Governance vs. Data Management: Key Differences & Real Examples
item.dc:creator: Sandy Bradbury
item.description: Confused about Data Governance vs. Data Management? Discover their key differences, real-world examples, and how both work together to protect your data.

item.title: Building a Data Governance Operating Model That People Actually Use
item.dc:creator: Sandy Bradbury
item.description: A practical guide to turning governance principles into clear decisions, useful routines, and measurable business outcomes.

item.title: Data Literacy Is a Business Capability, Not a Training Event
item.dc:creator: Sandy Bradbury
item.description: Move beyond one-off courses and build the habits, language, and support systems that make confident data use repeatable.

item.title: Responsible AI Starts with Data Governance
item.dc:creator: Sandy Bradbury
item.description: AI controls become more effective when ownership, lineage, quality, and acceptable use are already part of the data lifecycle.
